chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim, from Mu'mmar ibn Khallad, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
It is not proper for a man to abandon using perfume every day; if he is unable to do so, then every other day; and if he is unable to do that, then every Friday. He should not abandon this practice.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended frequency for using perfume according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) outlines a graduated approach to using perfume, emphasizing its role in enhancing personal presentation and social courtesy. This hadith reflects the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) and cleanliness as acts of worship, encouraging believers to maintain a pleasant scent daily if possible, otherwise every other day, and at minimum, every Friday to honor the congregational prayer. This practice aligns with the broader Islamic tradition of preparing oneself for communal worship and social interactions.
